Question 2
?

Find the differential df for the function f(x,y)=x2+y2.

a
 x2dx+y2dy
b
 xdx+ydy
c
 (2x+y2)dx+(x2+2y)dy
d
 (x+y2)dx+(x2+y)dy
e
 2xdx+2ydy
